title: What should I read for you?
dropTitle: Drop a file or click to upload
dropFormats: PDF, CSV, Markdown, TXT, HTML, JSON
pageHint: To summarize a web page, click the extension icon on that page, or right-click and choose “Summarize this page”.

video.noCaptions: This video has no captions, so it can’t be summarized
video.live: Live streams can be summarized after they end

tabs.hint: Summarize and compare up to {{max}} tabs together. Siftlume asks to see your tabs, then to read the ones you pick.
tabs.title: Tabs in this window
tabs.none: Open at least two web pages in this window to combine them.
tabs.denied: Siftlume needs that permission to read your tabs.

meet.intro: Siftlume records Meet's live captions, with who said what, so it can summarize the meeting: decisions, action items with owners, open questions. Join the call first.
meet.noCaptions: No captions yet. Turn on captions in Meet (the CC button, or press c); recording picks them up as soon as they appear.
meet.notInCall: Join the call to start capturing what is said.
meet.privacy: Captions stay in this browser until you summarize; then the transcript goes to your AI provider like any page.
meet.openPanel: Record this meeting in the side panel
